observations: White game console with a vertical slot on the side, characteristic of the PS5 Slim model.
The console is partially obscured by a white box with 'PS5' and 'FC87' printed on it.
Four physical game cases are visible: FC87, Mortal Kombat 11, F1 25, and Uncharted 4.
A white DualSense controller is placed in front of the games.
A grey textured carrying case with 'PS5 SLIM' printed on it is on the right.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The storage capacity is not visible on the console or the case.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted and the game launching.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the system menu.
Video of a disc being inserted and the game launching.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
